run.commands: Tenant/run/command/step/next/policy hash; attempt version/claim_epoch are fences, excluded from identity. Same command returns saved original outcome before stale-fence rejection. Differing hash conflicts. New command uses checkpoint CAS. Cancellation completion requires tenant-scoped policy evidence and no unresolved/unknown effects.
run.storage: Adapter must atomically CAS checkpoint + command outcome; reducer is pure and does not claim database durability.
run.delivery: Separate DeliveryIntent/OperationReceipt; Run terminal status does not rewrite delivery/action outcomes.

registry.registration: Code-only ActionRegistration(ActionDefinition, ActionHandler); no model/config hydration, dynamic FQN/SQL/URL resolution or effect invocation.
registry.definition_hash: sha-256(JCS({revision: platform/action-definition/v1, id, version, ...metadata})); global immutable code content, not a tenant submission identity.
views: executionView: pinned definition + opaque owner binding after current access intersection
modelView: allowed definition refs + canonical input schema
adminView: allowed definition refs + full immutable metadata
registry.schema: Canonical immutable JSON schema strings; all views derive from one inputSchema. Local InputSchemaValidator port validates exact same schema before submit. Schema ref resolution must remain local/fail closed.

actions.submission: ActionSubmission binds raw input to tenant-scoped action-input hash and typed ActionRequest. No assistant is needed.
actions.submit_returns: Actions/ActionReceipt contains safe ActionView: existing Common/ActionReceipt dated action ref/status/version + pinned definition_ref/hash + safeNextStep. It means durable accepted only when lifecycle adapter has committed, never completed by inference.
actions.lifecycle_port: Actions/ActionLifecycle owns atomic submission-key reservation and dated journal delegation. SDK bridge must use ActionReducer/EventStore, ConfirmationService and IdempotencyCoordinator; no replacement reducer, token protocol or effect loop.
actions.status: Refresh host context; tenant-scoped safe metadata only; check pinned registration and current intersection before disclosure.
actions.cancel: Durable request; terminal receipt and definition/result refs cannot change. Compensation is a separate explicit authorized action.
actions.reconcile: No caller-supplied owner operation key. Adapter loads original saved key, queries status, CAS known outcome. Unknown/missing stays backoff/manual with reconciliation_required and no write retry.
actions.mapping: Common/ActionPhaseMapping validates journal status: pending->created; ready->running with internal eligibility; executing->applying; succeeded->completed; reconciling->reconciliation_required. Cancellation is event/flag, no new dated ActionStatus.
actions.dispatch_guards: Facade checks do not grant effect execution. Adapter/owner must recheck current permissions, emergency/revocation, confirmation, deadline, admission and hardened idempotency at dispatch.
actions.operation_receipts: cancel returns CancelReceipt(commandRef, view); reconcile returns ReconcileReceipt(commandRef, view). Status returns ActionView. Receipt wrappers add no new wire status.

limitations: Pure unit contracts only. Scripted memory lifecycle in tests is not a production adapter or a database.
RUN-007 and V2ALL-STATES-* exercise core boundaries at unit tier here; isolated PostgreSQL concurrency/recovery and host e2e are pending their owning adapters.
SDK dated reducer is reused in tests; actual production SDK bridge/confirmation/write composition belongs to owning P3/P5 slices. No provider/production readiness claim.
